# X is down for thousands of users who complain of broken timelines, error messages on platform

By

Ariel Zilber

Published  June 22, 2026, 10:18 a.m. ET

See more of our coverage in your search results.

X users were left staring at error messages and broken timelines Monday morning after Elon Musk’s social media platform suffered a widespread outage that triggered a flood of complaints across the internet.

Problems appeared to begin shortly after 9 a.m. Eastern time, according to Downdetector, which showed reports of issues with X skyrocketing to nearly 30,000 within minutes after tracking only a handful of complaints earlier in the morning.
